results.title: [PDF] Tangping (Lying Flat): Subjectivation, Lifestyles, and Voice among ...
results.content: Tangping (Lying Flat): Subjectivation, Lifestyles, and Voice among Young Chinese Tangping (Restons couché(e)s) : subjectivation, styles de vie et opinions parmi la jeunesse chinoise Jean-Louis Rocca Sciences Po, CERI Email : jeanlouis.rocca@sciencespo.fr Abstract: Since the 2010s, new cultural phenomena have emerged in China among the young generation of people born during the “Chinese Miracle”, all challenging the norms and values that the previous generation helped to create. Even though France has been described, by comparison with China, as a “lying flat country” , a young French sinologist wrote: “As I read about this concept [Tangping] for the first time in the spring of 2021, I immediately felt connected to the term as I had started lying flat after completing my PhD in Chinese Studies in 2018” .148 About the author Jean-Louis Rocca is Professor at Sciences Po, Paris, and Researcher at the Center for International Studies (CERI), Sciences Po. He is currently working on Chinese society, particularly the middle class and social and cultural movements.
